svg.title: NFSU2 Win32 & DirectX 9 Translation Progress
svg.desc: 288 implemented, 7 stubbed, 50 missing out of 345 tracked APIs (84.5% coverage).
svg.text: SPEED2.EXE ARM64 / Android HLE Surface Coverage
Library implementation status and function coverage for Need for Speed: Underground 2 recompilation.
Each cell represents an imported function or COM method. Hover over cells for implementation details.
